(function () {
  function isLikelyDecorative(img) {
    const src = (img.getAttribute('src') || '').toLowerCase();
    const className = (img.className || '').toString().toLowerCase();
    const width = img.naturalWidth || img.width || 0;
    const height = img.naturalHeight || img.height || 0;

    // Skip tiny images, icons, logos, svg assets, spacer gifs, etc.
    if (width && height && width <= 48 && height <= 48) return true;

    const decorativePatterns = [
      'icon',
      'logo',
      'arrow',
      'divider',
      'pattern',
      'bg-',
      'background',
      'spacer',
      'placeholder',
      'loading',
      'bullet'
    ];

    if (decorativePatterns.some(term => className.includes(term))) return true;
    if (decorativePatterns.some(term => src.includes(term))) return true;

    if (img.closest('[aria-hidden="true"], [role="presentation"], .decorative')) return true;

    return false;
  }

  function cleanFilenameToAlt(src) {
    if (!src) return '';

    let filename = src.split('/').pop().split('?')[0];

    filename = filename
      .replace(/\.[a-z0-9]+$/i, '')                 // remove file extension
      .replace(/[-_]\d+x\d+$/i, '')                 // remove resize suffix (e.g. -300x300)
      .replace(/\b(hubfs|file|image|img)\b/gi, '')  // remove generic CMS words
      .replace(/\b[0-9a-f]{8,}\b/gi, '')            // remove long hash strings
      .replace(/%20/g, ' ')                         // convert encoded spaces
      .replace(/[_-]+/g, ' ')                       // replace _ and - with spaces
      .replace(/\d+/g, '')                          // remove standalone numbers
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')                         // normalize spaces
      .trim();

    // Capitalize words
    filename = filename
      .split(' ')
      .map(word => word.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + word.slice(1))
      .join(' ');

    if (!filename) return '';

    const badExact = ['image', 'photo', 'img', 'graphic', 'banner', 'untitled'];
    if (badExact.includes(filename.toLowerCase())) return '';

    return filename.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + filename.slice(1);
  }

  function applyMissingAltFallback(root) {
    const scope = root || document;
    const images = scope.querySelectorAll('img:not([alt]), img[alt=""], img[alt=" "]');

    images.forEach(function (img) {
      if (!img || !img.src) return;
      if (isLikelyDecorative(img)) return;

      const generatedAlt = cleanFilenameToAlt(img.currentSrc || img.src);
      if (!generatedAlt || generatedAlt.length < 3) return;

      img.setAttribute('alt', generatedAlt);
    });

    function isTrustedDomain(hostname) {
